# Fixtures

MINIMAL.hpprgm is the unchanged, MIT-licensed program-container fixture from
HP Prime Emulator, tests/hpprgm/files/MINIMAL.hpprgm, at commit
8d7535ec432e3c66f4f210f32a4ae58c5911d96d. It returns 1. No calculator
was accessed to obtain or run it. Other fixtures are toolkit test programs.


BSTVisualizer.hpprgm is the unchanged real BST application supplied for native
desktop integration, SHA-256
`e80fa7d05197f54fdaca1eee7a2657ee5102b7209ca48e49ada3116043381783`.
It exercises drawing, GETKEY, MOUSE, INPUT, CHOOSE, and tree mutation. It is
distinct from upstream's same-named entry-selection fixture, which only returns
constants. No calculator was accessed to obtain or exercise this source.
